name: M7.RecoveryPrefix.leaf_singleton
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) (p : List Bool), p.length = M7.PrefixBits.depth N → M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E p ⊆ {M7.RecoveryPrefix.leaf N p}
guidance: Unfold the actual completed/leaf as decodePair image. PrefixBits.leaf_singleton says the natural completion set lies in the one selected pair. Any image member is therefore exactly the decoded leaf. Include N=1 depth zero and empty/invalid completion sets without an existence assumption. Return tactic lines without leading by; keep exact frozen target and default limits.
